title: [RPG Design Guides] Setting Up the Final Boss

blocks.source: 【RPG制作講座】ラスボスの設定
blocks.translation: [RPG Design Guides] Setting Up the Final Boss

blocks.source: ストーリーを作成するために、できるだけ早い段階で決めておきたい事として『旅立つ理由』と『最終目的』の２つが挙げられる。その内、最終目的は大半の場合、最後の敵――つまりラスボスを倒すことに直結する。
blocks.translation: When creating a story, two things you should decide as early as possible are the “reason for setting out” and the “ultimate goal.” In most cases, the ultimate goal is directly connected to defeating the final enemy—in other words, the final boss.

blocks.source: 今回はそんなラスボスを焦点として、ストーリー制作について考えてみたい。その過程で、既存ＲＰＧのラスボスも分析してみた。
blocks.translation: This time, I would like to focus on the final boss and think about story creation. In the process, I also analyzed the final bosses of existing RPGs.

blocks.source: ラスボスの役割
blocks.translation: The Role of the Final Boss

blocks.source: ラスボスは最後の壁として、ストーリー的にもゲーム的にも、作品を締める役割を持っている。
blocks.translation: As the final obstacle, the final boss serves to bring the work to a close, both in terms of the story and the gameplay.

blocks.source: ラスボスがいないＲＰＧとは『犯人がいない推理小説』のようなものであり、盛り上がりに欠ける。
blocks.translation: An RPG without a final boss is like “a mystery novel with no culprit,” and lacks excitement.

blocks.source: ちなみに、筆者は『犯人がいない推理小説』を実際に読んだことがあるが、かなりガックリきた記憶がある。３００～４００ページ規模の長編で、自殺と見せかけた他殺……と見せかけて、やっぱり自殺というオチだった。動機も宗教じみて意味不明。個人的に、こういう脱力系のオチが許されるのは短編までだと思う。
blocks.translation: Incidentally, I have actually read “a mystery novel with no culprit,” and I remember being quite disappointed. It was a 300- to 400-page novel in which the ending turned out to be a murder disguised as suicide… only for it to ultimately be suicide after all. The motive was also religious in nature and made no sense. Personally, I think this kind of deflating ending is only acceptable in a short story.

blocks.source: ラスボスに必要な要素
blocks.translation: Elements Required for a Final Boss

blocks.source: まず、必要なのは『主人公と戦う理由』だろう。
blocks.translation: First, what is needed is probably a “reason to fight the protagonist.”

blocks.source: 多くの場合は『世界征服』『人類抹殺』といった大規模な悪事を企んでおり、主人公はそれに立ち向かうという構造になる。
blocks.translation: In many cases, the final boss is plotting some large-scale evil, such as “conquering the world” or “wiping out humanity,” and the protagonist is structured as someone who stands against it.

blocks.source: 同情できる理由がある場合など、ラスボスは必ずしも悪役とは限らない。それでも、主人公達がその目的を阻止するという点は変わらない。
blocks.translation: The final boss is not necessarily a villain; for example, they may have a reason that elicits sympathy. Even so, the fact that the protagonists must stop that goal remains unchanged.

blocks.source: 次に必要となるのは『強大な力』。
blocks.translation: The next thing needed is “overwhelming power.”

blocks.source: 最後の敵である以上、これまでの敵を越える力を持っているべきだ。ゲームバランス上は今までのボスよりも、パラメータを高く設定するだけで済むが、物語上もその裏付けがないと説得力を欠いてしまう。
blocks.translation: As the final enemy, it should possess power surpassing that of all previous enemies. In terms of game balance, simply setting its parameters higher than those of previous bosses is enough, but without a narrative basis for that strength, the story loses credibility.

blocks.source: ＤＱ１のように、神や竜など最初から強大な力を持った敵として登場させるなら特に説明不要だ。そうでない場合は物語の途中で力を得る描写をする必要がある。
blocks.translation: If the enemy appears from the beginning as a being with immense power, such as a god or dragon, as in DQ1, no particular explanation is necessary. Otherwise, you need to depict it gaining power during the story.

blocks.source: ラスボスの登場パターン
blocks.translation: Patterns for Introducing the Final Boss

blocks.source: 既存ＲＰＧのラスボスがどうやってシナリオ上に姿を表し、どのようにラスボスとして君臨するのかを適当にまとめてみた。
blocks.translation: I have put together a rough summary of how the final bosses of existing RPGs appear in the scenarios and come to reign as the final boss.

blocks.source: 大抵のＲＰＧのラスボスは以下のいずれかに該当するはず。中には複数のパターンを兼ね備えている場合もある。
blocks.translation: Most RPG final bosses should fall into one of the following categories. Some combine multiple patterns.

blocks.source: なお、例としてＤＱ、ＦＦ、サガの各シリーズ作品を例に挙げてみた。それ以外でも、自分がプレイしたことがある作品がどれに該当するのかを考えてみるのも面白いかと。
blocks.translation: For these examples, I have listed titles from the DQ, FF, and SaGa series. It may also be interesting to consider which category other games you have played fall into.

blocks.source: 初期型
blocks.translation: The Initial Type

blocks.source: 序盤から強大な敵として示された相手が、そのままラスボスとなるタイプ。
blocks.translation: The type in which an opponent presented as a powerful enemy from the early stages ultimately becomes the final boss.

blocks.source: どのようにして主人公は強大な敵と立ち向かうのかがポイントとなる。最も単純なパターンだが、濃いストーリーを練る余地も十分にある。
blocks.translation: The key is how the protagonist confronts this powerful enemy. It is the simplest pattern, but there is still plenty of room to develop a rich story.

blocks.source: 例えば、ＦＦ７や１０ではラスボスの正体や目的について、物語が進む中で徐々に明らかにされていくという構成になっている。
blocks.translation: For example, in FFVII and FFX, the final boss’s true identity and objectives are gradually revealed as the story progresses.

blocks.source: 例：ＤＱ１、ＦＦ２、ＦＦ７、ＦＦ１０、ロマサガ２
blocks.translation: Examples: DQ1, FFII, FFVII, FFX, Romancing SaGa 2

blocks.source: 復活型（召喚型）
blocks.translation: The Resurrection (Summoning) Type

blocks.source: 過去に封印されたはずの魔王や邪神が復活、あるいは召喚されてラスボスに――というパターン。
blocks.translation: A demon king or evil god that was supposedly sealed away in the past is resurrected or summoned and becomes the final boss—this is another pattern.

blocks.source: 「どういう経緯で復活するか、召喚されるか」がシナリオ上の見せどころ。
blocks.translation: The scenario’s key appeal is “the circumstances behind how it is resurrected or summoned.”

blocks.source: 主人公達は阻止しようと努力をするが、結局……というパターンが読めてしまうのが難点。
blocks.translation: The drawback is that although the protagonists strive to prevent it, the predictable outcome is ultimately… well, you can see where this is going.

blocks.source: そのラスボスは「過去に何をして、誰にどうやって封印されたのか」といった歴史も欲しい。
blocks.translation: This type of final boss also needs a history, such as “what it did in the past, and who sealed it away and how.”

blocks.source: 登場時期が遅いので、インパクトも意外性もない場合は影が薄くなりがち。
blocks.translation: Because it appears late in the story, it tends to fade into the background if it lacks impact or a surprise.

blocks.source: 例：ＤＱ２、ＤＱ７、ＤＱ８、ＦＦ３、ＦＦ５、ＦＦＴ、ロマサガ１、サガフロ２
blocks.translation: Examples: DQ2, DQ7, DQ8, FFIII, FFV, FFT, Romancing SaGa 1, SaGa Frontier 2

blocks.source: ※たぶんＦＦ９もここだと思います。唐突かつ意味不明なので困難ですが……。
blocks.translation: ※FFIX probably belongs here too. It is difficult to categorize because its appearance is abrupt and makes little sense…

blocks.source: 大ボス型
blocks.translation: The Greater Boss Type

blocks.source: 倒したボスを裏で操っていた、さらなる大ボスの存在が明かされる。
blocks.translation: The existence of an even greater boss, who had been manipulating the defeated boss from behind the scenes, is revealed.

blocks.source: あるいは、「魔王を倒したが、宇宙人が襲って来た」というように、戦っていた当面の敵とは全く別の第３勢力が現れる場合も。
blocks.translation: Alternatively, an entirely separate third faction may appear, unrelated to the immediate enemy the protagonists had been fighting—for example, “they defeated the demon king, but then aliens attacked.”

blocks.source: ＤＱ３のようにインパクトのある登場が有効――とは言っても、あれは過去作を活用した上での補正＆当時だから受けた演出であって、今同じことをやって、評価を得るのは難しいかも。
blocks.translation: A dramatic entrance like the one in DQ3 can be effective—but that scene benefited from its use of elements from previous games and from being presented in its era. Doing the same thing now might not receive much acclaim.

blocks.source: 登場時期が遅いので、インパクトも意外性もない場合は影が薄くなりがち――というのは『復活型』と一緒。
blocks.translation: The fact that it appears late in the story and tends to fade into the background without impact or surprise is the same as with the “Resurrection Type.”

blocks.source: 以下の例に挙げた作品は、伏線も何もなく登場するというパターンが多い。
blocks.translation: Many of the works listed below follow the pattern of introducing the final boss without foreshadowing or any prior setup.

blocks.source: 作品の世界・歴史設定に関わるような遠大な伏線を張ると良いかも。
blocks.translation: It may be a good idea to lay extensive foreshadowing connected to the world and history of the work.

blocks.source: 例：ＤＱ３、ＤＱ５、ＤＱ６、ＦＦ４、ＦＦ８
blocks.translation: Examples: DQ3, DQ5, DQ6, FFIV, FFVIII

blocks.source: 黒幕型
blocks.translation: The Mastermind Type

blocks.source: 「倒したボスを裏で操っていた」というのは『大ボス型』と同じだが、ストーリーの傾向がかなり変わるので別枠に分類してみた。
blocks.translation: “The one who had been manipulating the defeated boss from behind the scenes” is the same as the “Greater Boss Type,” but I have classified it separately because the story tends to develop quite differently.

blocks.source: 既存の登場人物が黒幕だったという衝撃的なパターンを指す。特に今まで味方だと思っていたキャラクターが実は――というのも定番。
blocks.translation: This refers to the shocking pattern in which an existing character turns out to be the mastermind. In particular, the classic twist is that a character thought to be an ally was actually—

blocks.source: 定番と言ったが、意外にもＤＱやＦＦには該当が少なく、他の作品を見てもわりとＲＰＧでは珍しかったりする。
blocks.translation: Although I called it a classic, surprisingly few DQ and FF titles fit this category, and it is relatively uncommon in RPGs even when looking at other games.

blocks.source: ミステリ小説的なドンデン返しのセンスが必要だが、インパクトは強いので是非。
blocks.translation: It requires the knack for a mystery-novel-style twist, but the impact is strong, so I highly recommend it.

blocks.source: これはファルコム作品なんかが上手だと思う。
blocks.translation: I think Falcom’s games handle this particularly well.

blocks.source: 例：ＦＦ１、サガ１
blocks.translation: Examples: FFI, SaGa 1

blocks.source: 成り上がり型
blocks.translation: The Rise-to-Power Type

blocks.source: 序盤から登場するライバル格の敵キャラクターが成り上がって敵の頂点に。
blocks.translation: An enemy character who appears from the early stages as a rival rises through the ranks to the top of the enemy forces.

blocks.source: 『どうやって』成り上がるかがポイント。
blocks.translation: The key is “how” they rise to power.

blocks.source: 『黒幕型』とも近いが、こちらは序盤から敵として認識されているところが差異。
blocks.translation: It is similar to the “Mastermind Type,” but the difference is that this character is recognized as an enemy from the beginning.

blocks.source: ＦＦ６のケフカのように下克上したり、ＤＱ４のデスピサロのように倒れた大ボスの後を引継いだりする。
blocks.translation: They may rise from a subordinate position, like Kefka in FF6, or take over after a fallen major boss, like Psaro in DQ4.

blocks.source: このタイプのキャラクターは最初から強大な力を持っているわけではなく、大抵は物語の途中に何らかの方法で力を得る描写がある。
blocks.translation: Characters of this type do not possess overwhelming power from the outset; in most cases, the story shows them obtaining power by some means along the way.

blocks.source: 例：ＤＱ４、ＦＦ６、ＦＦ１２
blocks.translation: Examples: DQ4, FF6, FF12

blocks.source: その他
blocks.translation: Other Patterns

blocks.source: 数は少なくなるが、上記以外のパターンも存在する。
blocks.translation: Though less common, other patterns exist as well.

blocks.source: サガ２、タクティクスオウガ、ヘラクレスの栄光３など。ただし、ラスボスの印象付けとしては、うまくいっていないかも。例に挙げた３作品とも、ストーリーの評価は高い部類だがラスボスのインパクトは弱め。
blocks.translation: Examples include SaGa 2, Tactics Ogre, and Glory of Heracles III. However, they may not be very effective at leaving an impression as final bosses. All three examples are highly regarded for their stories, but their final bosses have relatively little impact.

blocks.source: 例えば、上記三作のラスボスは、主人公達とは因縁が薄かったり、そもそも最終目的とも関係性が薄かったりする。
blocks.translation: For example, the final bosses in the three works mentioned above have few ties to the protagonists, or little connection to the ultimate objective in the first place.

blocks.source: ラストダンジョンにて、襲って来たから倒すという流れである。
blocks.translation: In the final dungeon, the progression is essentially: they attack, so you defeat them.

blocks.source: ※実はヘラクレスの栄光３のラスボスには「とある人物の行為の是否」という明確な対立点があるのだが、セリフ回しのせいで八つ当たりか何かにしか見えない。
blocks.translation: ※In fact, the final boss of Glory of Heracles III has a clear point of conflict: whether a certain person's actions were right or wrong. However, the dialogue makes it look like nothing more than taking out their frustration on someone.

blocks.source: 上記作品のボスは意外ではあるかもしれないが、それはそれまでのストーリーから乖離していて、プレイヤーに予想がつかないからでもある。
blocks.translation: The bosses in the works mentioned above may be surprising, but that is partly because they are disconnected from the preceding story and therefore impossible for players to anticipate.

blocks.source: 意外だからといって、プレイヤーの期待に応えているとも言い難い。やはり、印象に残るラスボスを作りたいならば、上記５パターンの要素を含める方が無難だと思われる。
blocks.translation: Just because something is unexpected does not necessarily mean it fulfills the player's expectations. Therefore, if you want to create a memorable final boss, it is probably safer to incorporate elements from the five patterns above.

blocks.source: ラスボス行動パターン
blocks.translation: Final Boss Behavior Patterns

blocks.source: 次にそれらラスボスに取ってありがちな行動・展開をまとめてみた。
blocks.translation: Next, I have summarized the actions and developments that are commonly associated with these final bosses.

blocks.source: 以下は色んな作品で多用される展開だが、それだけにラスボスを印象付ける効果があるとも言える。
blocks.translation: The developments below are frequently used in many works, but that is precisely why they can be effective at making the final boss memorable.

blocks.source: 悪事
blocks.translation: Evil Deeds

blocks.source: 『世界征服』や『人類抹殺』を目指して、様々な行動を繰り広げる。
blocks.translation: They undertake various actions in pursuit of “world domination” or “the extermination of humanity.”

blocks.source: 直接的な破壊活動もあれば、政治的な謀略もあったりと様々。組織的に部下へ指示したり、自ら手を汚したりする。
blocks.translation: These can take many forms, from direct acts of destruction to political scheming. They may issue organized orders to their subordinates or get their own hands dirty.

blocks.source: これによって、ラスボスがいかに倒すべき相手であるかを強調するわけである。
blocks.translation: This emphasizes how much the final boss is someone who must be defeated.

blocks.source: 動機付け
blocks.translation: Motivation

blocks.source: ＤＱの魔王のように最初から人類と敵対しているような設定なら、特に深く考えることはない。それ以外の場合は、ラスボスがラスボスへと至るまでの動機付けを行う必要がある。
blocks.translation: If the setting establishes from the outset that the villain is hostile to humanity, like the Demon King in DQ, there is no need to think too deeply about it. Otherwise, you need to establish the motivation that leads the final boss to become the final boss.

blocks.source: 例えば、ＤＱ４のデスピサロは当初から人間に敵対する存在であるが、物語後半のイベントで人間を滅ぼすという動機を強くする。
blocks.translation: For example, Psaro in DQ4 is hostile to humans from the beginning, but events in the latter half of the story strengthen his motivation to destroy humanity.

blocks.source: ＦＦ７では物語開始地点より前に動機づけのイベントがあるため、主人公の回想という形で挿入される。
blocks.translation: In FF7, an event that provides the motivation takes place before the story begins, so it is inserted in the form of the protagonist's recollection.

blocks.source: 対決（戦闘）
blocks.translation: Confrontation (Battle)

blocks.source: ラスボスが最終的に主人公と対決するのは当たり前だが、ここで言う『対決』とは物語途中での対決イベントのこと。これによって、主人公と敵との因縁を強調する効果がある。
blocks.translation: It goes without saying that the final boss ultimately confronts the protagonist, but the “confrontation” referred to here is a confrontation event that takes place during the story. This helps emphasize the ties between the protagonist and the enemy.

blocks.source: 今後の展開をどうしたいかによって勝敗は変わる。
blocks.translation: The outcome depends on how you want the story to develop from that point onward.

blocks.source: 主人公が敗北する（強制敗北戦闘）ならば、「勝つためにはどうしたらいいのか？」というように物語を繋げることができる。
blocks.translation: If the protagonist is defeated (a forced-loss battle), the story can continue with questions such as, “What must we do to win?”

blocks.source: 主人公が勝つならば、その時点ではまだラスボスとして不足ということ。今後のパワーアップイベントが期待される。
blocks.translation: If the protagonist wins, the enemy is not yet sufficient as a final boss at that point. Players can then look forward to a power-up event later on.

blocks.source: 直接対決を後半まで焦らしたいという場合は、部下に戦わせるというパターンも存在する。
blocks.translation: If you want to delay a direct confrontation until the latter half of the story, another pattern is to have the protagonist fight the boss's subordinates instead.

blocks.source: 強化
blocks.translation: Power-Up

blocks.source: ラスボスキャラのパワーアップイベントのこと。
blocks.translation: This refers to a power-up event for the final boss character.

blocks.source: 『成り上がり型』の様に物語開始時点では十分な力を備えていない敵が、ラスボスに昇格するために行われることが多い。『黒幕型』の場合は自らのパワーアップのため、色々と陰謀を巡らしたりすることも。
blocks.translation: As with the “rise-to-power type,” this is often done to promote an enemy who does not have sufficient power at the beginning of the story to the position of final boss. In the “mastermind type,” they may also devise various schemes to power themselves up.

blocks.source: 【パワーアップイベントの例】
blocks.translation: [Examples of Power-Up Events]

blocks.source: パワースポットから力を手に入れる。
blocks.translation: Obtain power from a power spot.

blocks.source: パワーアイテムを手に入れる。
blocks.translation: Obtain a power-up item.

blocks.source: 魔法や科学の力で自らを改造する。
blocks.translation: Modify themselves using magic or science.

blocks.source: 他者からエネルギーを吸収する。
blocks.translation: Absorb energy from others.

blocks.source: 神など強大な存在から力を得る。
blocks.translation: Gain power from a mighty being such as a god.

blocks.source: 復活
blocks.translation: Resurrection

blocks.source: 復活型（召喚型）ラスボスが復活するまでの工程のこと。
blocks.translation: This refers to the process leading up to the resurrection of a resurrection-type (summoning-type) final boss.

blocks.source: 大抵の場合、ラスボスを復活させるために何らかの条件が課せられており、それを満たすために誰かが頑張ることになる。
blocks.translation: In most cases, some condition must be met to resurrect the final boss, and someone works hard to fulfill it.

blocks.source: 候補としては『ラスボスの部下』『ラスボスに操られた誰か』『力を失ったラスボス当人』『ラスボスの力を利用しようとする誰か』などである。
blocks.translation: Candidates include “a subordinate of the final boss,” “someone controlled by the final boss,” “the final boss themselves after losing their power,” and “someone trying to use the final boss's power,” among others.

blocks.source: ＤＱ８やＦＦ５では、物語上で長い時間を割いて、その様子を描写している。
blocks.translation: In DQ8 and FF5, a considerable amount of story time is devoted to depicting this process.

blocks.source: 【復活条件の例】
blocks.translation: [Examples of Resurrection Conditions]

blocks.source: 封印に使用されている『何か』を破壊する。
blocks.translation: Destroy the “something” used to seal them away.

blocks.source: 生贄を捧げる。特定の人物だったり、大量の人間だったり。
blocks.translation: Offer a sacrifice. This may be a specific person or a large number of people.

blocks.source: 『何か』を集める。
blocks.translation: Collect the “something.”

blocks.source: 依代（人間あるいは物）を見つける。
blocks.translation: Find a vessel (a person or an object).

blocks.source: まとめ
blocks.translation: Conclusion

blocks.source: 魅力あるラスボスの存在はそれだけで、物語を引き締める効果がある。
blocks.translation: The mere presence of an appealing final boss can help give a story greater focus.

blocks.source: 『悪のカリスマ』を目指すも良し、『悲劇の宿敵』を目指すも良し。
blocks.translation: You can aim for an “evil charismatic figure” or a “tragic nemesis.”

blocks.source: どのようなラスボスを目指すかで、ストーリーの方向性も変わってくる。
blocks.translation: The direction of the story will also change depending on what kind of final boss you aim to create.

blocks.source: 作品によっては、物語の多くの部分をラスボスに関するイベントで占めることもある。その場合、ラスボスの設定を決定すれば、物語の枠組みも決まってくるというわけだ。
blocks.translation: In some works, events related to the final boss may occupy much of the story. In that case, deciding on the final boss's setting also determines the framework of the story.

blocks.source: ストーリーが思いつかない場合は、ラスボスを起点に物語を考えてみるのも手だろう。
blocks.translation: If you cannot think of a story, one option is to start with the final boss and build the story from there.

texts.ストーリーを作成するために、できるだけ早い段階で決めておきたい事として『旅立つ理: When creating a story, two things you should decide as early as possible are the “reason for setting out” and the “ultimate goal.” In most cases, the ultimate goal is directly connected to defeating the final enemy—in other words, the final boss.
texts.今回はそんなラスボスを焦点として、ストーリー制作について考えてみたい。その過程で: This time, I would like to focus on the final boss and think about story creation. In the process, I also analyzed the final bosses of existing RPGs.
texts.ラスボスの役割: The Role of the Final Boss
texts.ラスボスは最後の壁として、ストーリー的にもゲーム的にも、作品を締める役割を持って: As the final obstacle, the final boss serves to bring the work to a close, both in terms of the story and the gameplay.
texts.ラスボスがいないＲＰＧとは『犯人がいない推理小説』のようなものであり、盛り上がり: An RPG without a final boss is like “a mystery novel with no culprit,” and lacks excitement.
texts.ちなみに、筆者は『犯人がいない推理小説』を実際に読んだことがあるが、かなりガック: Incidentally, I have actually read “a mystery novel with no culprit,” and I remember being quite disappointed. It was a 300- to 400-page novel in which the ending turned out to be a murder disguised as suicide… only for it to ultimately be suicide after all. The motive was also religious in nature and made no sense. Personally, I think this kind of deflating ending is only acceptable in a short story.
texts.ラスボスに必要な要素: Elements Required for a Final Boss
texts.まず、必要なのは『主人公と戦う理由』だろう。: First, what is needed is probably a “reason to fight the protagonist.”
texts.多くの場合は『世界征服』『人類抹殺』といった大規模な悪事を企んでおり、主人公はそ: In many cases, the final boss is plotting some large-scale evil, such as “conquering the world” or “wiping out humanity,” and the protagonist is structured as someone who stands against it.
texts.同情できる理由がある場合など、ラスボスは必ずしも悪役とは限らない。それでも、主人: The final boss is not necessarily a villain; for example, they may have a reason that elicits sympathy. Even so, the fact that the protagonists must stop that goal remains unchanged.
texts.次に必要となるのは『強大な力』。: The next thing needed is “overwhelming power.”
texts.最後の敵である以上、これまでの敵を越える力を持っているべきだ。ゲームバランス上は: As the final enemy, it should possess power surpassing that of all previous enemies. In terms of game balance, simply setting its parameters higher than those of previous bosses is enough, but without a narrative basis for that strength, the story loses credibility.
texts.ＤＱ１のように、神や竜など最初から強大な力を持った敵として登場させるなら特に説明: If the enemy appears from the beginning as a being with immense power, such as a god or dragon, as in DQ1, no particular explanation is necessary. Otherwise, you need to depict it gaining power during the story.
texts.ラスボスの登場パターン: Patterns for Introducing the Final Boss
texts.既存ＲＰＧのラスボスがどうやってシナリオ上に姿を表し、どのようにラスボスとして君: I have put together a rough summary of how the final bosses of existing RPGs appear in the scenarios and come to reign as the final boss.
texts.大抵のＲＰＧのラスボスは以下のいずれかに該当するはず。中には複数のパターンを兼ね: Most RPG final bosses should fall into one of the following categories. Some combine multiple patterns.
texts.なお、例としてＤＱ、ＦＦ、サガの各シリーズ作品を例に挙げてみた。それ以外でも、自: For these examples, I have listed titles from the DQ, FF, and SaGa series. It may also be interesting to consider which category other games you have played fall into.
texts.序盤から強大な敵として示された相手が、そのままラスボスとなるタイプ。: The type in which an opponent presented as a powerful enemy from the early stages ultimately becomes the final boss.
texts.どのようにして主人公は強大な敵と立ち向かうのかがポイントとなる。最も単純なパター: The key is how the protagonist confronts this powerful enemy. It is the simplest pattern, but there is still plenty of room to develop a rich story.
texts.例えば、ＦＦ７や１０ではラスボスの正体や目的について、物語が進む中で徐々に明らか: For example, in FFVII and FFX, the final boss’s true identity and objectives are gradually revealed as the story progresses.
texts.例：ＤＱ１、ＦＦ２、ＦＦ７、ＦＦ１０、ロマサガ２: Examples: DQ1, FFII, FFVII, FFX, Romancing SaGa 2
texts.過去に封印されたはずの魔王や邪神が復活、あるいは召喚されてラスボスに――というパ: A demon king or evil god that was supposedly sealed away in the past is resurrected or summoned and becomes the final boss—this is another pattern.
texts.「どういう経緯で復活するか、召喚されるか」がシナリオ上の見せどころ。: The scenario’s key appeal is “the circumstances behind how it is resurrected or summoned.”
texts.主人公達は阻止しようと努力をするが、結局……というパターンが読めてしまうのが難点: The drawback is that although the protagonists strive to prevent it, the predictable outcome is ultimately… well, you can see where this is going.
texts.そのラスボスは「過去に何をして、誰にどうやって封印されたのか」といった歴史も欲し: This type of final boss also needs a history, such as “what it did in the past, and who sealed it away and how.”
texts.登場時期が遅いので、インパクトも意外性もない場合は影が薄くなりがち。: Because it appears late in the story, it tends to fade into the background if it lacks impact or a surprise.
texts.例：ＤＱ２、ＤＱ７、ＤＱ８、ＦＦ３、ＦＦ５、ＦＦＴ、ロマサガ１、サガフロ２: Examples: DQ2, DQ7, DQ8, FFIII, FFV, FFT, Romancing SaGa 1, SaGa Frontier 2
texts.※たぶんＦＦ９もここだと思います。唐突かつ意味不明なので困難ですが……。: ※FFIX probably belongs here too. It is difficult to categorize because its appearance is abrupt and makes little sense…
texts.倒したボスを裏で操っていた、さらなる大ボスの存在が明かされる。: The existence of an even greater boss, who had been manipulating the defeated boss from behind the scenes, is revealed.
texts.あるいは、「魔王を倒したが、宇宙人が襲って来た」というように、戦っていた当面の敵: Alternatively, an entirely separate third faction may appear, unrelated to the immediate enemy the protagonists had been fighting—for example, “they defeated the demon king, but then aliens attacked.”
texts.ＤＱ３のようにインパクトのある登場が有効――とは言っても、あれは過去作を活用した: A dramatic entrance like the one in DQ3 can be effective—but that scene benefited from its use of elements from previous games and from being presented in its era. Doing the same thing now might not receive much acclaim.
texts.登場時期が遅いので、インパクトも意外性もない場合は影が薄くなりがち――というのは: The fact that it appears late in the story and tends to fade into the background without impact or surprise is the same as with the “Resurrection Type.”
texts.以下の例に挙げた作品は、伏線も何もなく登場するというパターンが多い。: Many of the works listed below follow the pattern of introducing the final boss without foreshadowing or any prior setup.
texts.作品の世界・歴史設定に関わるような遠大な伏線を張ると良いかも。: It may be a good idea to lay extensive foreshadowing connected to the world and history of the work.
texts.例：ＤＱ３、ＤＱ５、ＤＱ６、ＦＦ４、ＦＦ８: Examples: DQ3, DQ5, DQ6, FFIV, FFVIII
texts.「倒したボスを裏で操っていた」というのは『大ボス型』と同じだが、ストーリーの傾向: “The one who had been manipulating the defeated boss from behind the scenes” is the same as the “Greater Boss Type,” but I have classified it separately because the story tends to develop quite differently.
texts.既存の登場人物が黒幕だったという衝撃的なパターンを指す。特に今まで味方だと思って: This refers to the shocking pattern in which an existing character turns out to be the mastermind. In particular, the classic twist is that a character thought to be an ally was actually—
texts.定番と言ったが、意外にもＤＱやＦＦには該当が少なく、他の作品を見てもわりとＲＰＧ: Although I called it a classic, surprisingly few DQ and FF titles fit this category, and it is relatively uncommon in RPGs even when looking at other games.
texts.ミステリ小説的なドンデン返しのセンスが必要だが、インパクトは強いので是非。: It requires the knack for a mystery-novel-style twist, but the impact is strong, so I highly recommend it.
texts.これはファルコム作品なんかが上手だと思う。: I think Falcom’s games handle this particularly well.
texts.序盤から登場するライバル格の敵キャラクターが成り上がって敵の頂点に。: An enemy character who appears from the early stages as a rival rises through the ranks to the top of the enemy forces.
texts.『どうやって』成り上がるかがポイント。: The key is “how” they rise to power.
texts.『黒幕型』とも近いが、こちらは序盤から敵として認識されているところが差異。: It is similar to the “Mastermind Type,” but the difference is that this character is recognized as an enemy from the beginning.
texts.ＦＦ６のケフカのように下克上したり、ＤＱ４のデスピサロのように倒れた大ボスの後を: They may rise from a subordinate position, like Kefka in FF6, or take over after a fallen major boss, like Psaro in DQ4.
texts.このタイプのキャラクターは最初から強大な力を持っているわけではなく、大抵は物語の: Characters of this type do not possess overwhelming power from the outset; in most cases, the story shows them obtaining power by some means along the way.
texts.数は少なくなるが、上記以外のパターンも存在する。: Though less common, other patterns exist as well.
texts.サガ２、タクティクスオウガ、ヘラクレスの栄光３など。ただし、ラスボスの印象付けと: Examples include SaGa 2, Tactics Ogre, and Glory of Heracles III. However, they may not be very effective at leaving an impression as final bosses. All three examples are highly regarded for their stories, but their final bosses have relatively little impact.
texts.例えば、上記三作のラスボスは、主人公達とは因縁が薄かったり、そもそも最終目的とも: For example, the final bosses in the three works mentioned above have few ties to the protagonists, or little connection to the ultimate objective in the first place.
texts.ラストダンジョンにて、襲って来たから倒すという流れである。: In the final dungeon, the progression is essentially: they attack, so you defeat them.
texts.※実はヘラクレスの栄光３のラスボスには「とある人物の行為の是否」という明確な対立: ※In fact, the final boss of Glory of Heracles III has a clear point of conflict: whether a certain person's actions were right or wrong. However, the dialogue makes it look like nothing more than taking out their frustration on someone.
texts.上記作品のボスは意外ではあるかもしれないが、それはそれまでのストーリーから乖離し: The bosses in the works mentioned above may be surprising, but that is partly because they are disconnected from the preceding story and therefore impossible for players to anticipate.
texts.意外だからといって、プレイヤーの期待に応えているとも言い難い。やはり、印象に残る: Just because something is unexpected does not necessarily mean it fulfills the player's expectations. Therefore, if you want to create a memorable final boss, it is probably safer to incorporate elements from the five patterns above.
texts.次にそれらラスボスに取ってありがちな行動・展開をまとめてみた。: Next, I have summarized the actions and developments that are commonly associated with these final bosses.
texts.以下は色んな作品で多用される展開だが、それだけにラスボスを印象付ける効果があると: The developments below are frequently used in many works, but that is precisely why they can be effective at making the final boss memorable.
texts.『世界征服』や『人類抹殺』を目指して、様々な行動を繰り広げる。: They undertake various actions in pursuit of “world domination” or “the extermination of humanity.”
texts.直接的な破壊活動もあれば、政治的な謀略もあったりと様々。組織的に部下へ指示したり: These can take many forms, from direct acts of destruction to political scheming. They may issue organized orders to their subordinates or get their own hands dirty.
texts.これによって、ラスボスがいかに倒すべき相手であるかを強調するわけである。: This emphasizes how much the final boss is someone who must be defeated.
texts.ＤＱの魔王のように最初から人類と敵対しているような設定なら、特に深く考えることは: If the setting establishes from the outset that the villain is hostile to humanity, like the Demon King in DQ, there is no need to think too deeply about it. Otherwise, you need to establish the motivation that leads the final boss to become the final boss.
texts.例えば、ＤＱ４のデスピサロは当初から人間に敵対する存在であるが、物語後半のイベン: For example, Psaro in DQ4 is hostile to humans from the beginning, but events in the latter half of the story strengthen his motivation to destroy humanity.
texts.ＦＦ７では物語開始地点より前に動機づけのイベントがあるため、主人公の回想という形: In FF7, an event that provides the motivation takes place before the story begins, so it is inserted in the form of the protagonist's recollection.
texts.ラスボスが最終的に主人公と対決するのは当たり前だが、ここで言う『対決』とは物語途: It goes without saying that the final boss ultimately confronts the protagonist, but the “confrontation” referred to here is a confrontation event that takes place during the story. This helps emphasize the ties between the protagonist and the enemy.
texts.今後の展開をどうしたいかによって勝敗は変わる。: The outcome depends on how you want the story to develop from that point onward.
texts.主人公が敗北する（強制敗北戦闘）ならば、「勝つためにはどうしたらいいのか？」とい: If the protagonist is defeated (a forced-loss battle), the story can continue with questions such as, “What must we do to win?”
texts.主人公が勝つならば、その時点ではまだラスボスとして不足ということ。今後のパワーア: If the protagonist wins, the enemy is not yet sufficient as a final boss at that point. Players can then look forward to a power-up event later on.
texts.直接対決を後半まで焦らしたいという場合は、部下に戦わせるというパターンも存在する: If you want to delay a direct confrontation until the latter half of the story, another pattern is to have the protagonist fight the boss's subordinates instead.
texts.ラスボスキャラのパワーアップイベントのこと。: This refers to a power-up event for the final boss character.
texts.『成り上がり型』の様に物語開始時点では十分な力を備えていない敵が、ラスボスに昇格: As with the “rise-to-power type,” this is often done to promote an enemy who does not have sufficient power at the beginning of the story to the position of final boss. In the “mastermind type,” they may also devise various schemes to power themselves up.
texts.パワースポットから力を手に入れる。: Obtain power from a power spot.
texts.魔法や科学の力で自らを改造する。: Modify themselves using magic or science.
texts.神など強大な存在から力を得る。: Gain power from a mighty being such as a god.
texts.復活型（召喚型）ラスボスが復活するまでの工程のこと。: This refers to the process leading up to the resurrection of a resurrection-type (summoning-type) final boss.
texts.大抵の場合、ラスボスを復活させるために何らかの条件が課せられており、それを満たす: In most cases, some condition must be met to resurrect the final boss, and someone works hard to fulfill it.
texts.候補としては『ラスボスの部下』『ラスボスに操られた誰か』『力を失ったラスボス当人: Candidates include “a subordinate of the final boss,” “someone controlled by the final boss,” “the final boss themselves after losing their power,” and “someone trying to use the final boss's power,” among others.
texts.ＤＱ８やＦＦ５では、物語上で長い時間を割いて、その様子を描写している。: In DQ8 and FF5, a considerable amount of story time is devoted to depicting this process.
texts.封印に使用されている『何か』を破壊する。: Destroy the “something” used to seal them away.
texts.生贄を捧げる。特定の人物だったり、大量の人間だったり。: Offer a sacrifice. This may be a specific person or a large number of people.
texts.依代（人間あるいは物）を見つける。: Find a vessel (a person or an object).
texts.魅力あるラスボスの存在はそれだけで、物語を引き締める効果がある。: The mere presence of an appealing final boss can help give a story greater focus.
texts.『悪のカリスマ』を目指すも良し、『悲劇の宿敵』を目指すも良し。: You can aim for an “evil charismatic figure” or a “tragic nemesis.”
texts.どのようなラスボスを目指すかで、ストーリーの方向性も変わってくる。: The direction of the story will also change depending on what kind of final boss you aim to create.
texts.作品によっては、物語の多くの部分をラスボスに関するイベントで占めることもある。そ: In some works, events related to the final boss may occupy much of the story. In that case, deciding on the final boss's setting also determines the framework of the story.
texts.ストーリーが思いつかない場合は、ラスボスを起点に物語を考えてみるのも手だろう。: If you cannot think of a story, one option is to start with the final boss and build the story from there.
